# ============================================================ # CORRECCIÓN MASIVA DE COSTE/MARGEN EN PEDIDOS POS # Acción planificada (ir.cron) — Modelo: pos.order # Procesa BATCH_SIZE pedidos por ejecución. Programar cada 15 min. # ============================================================
# --- Constantes de configuración (revisar antes de activar) --- MARKER = 'corrección costes 23/06/2026 error master data leche almendra' # Nota + barrera de idempotencia PRODUCT_ID = 6117 # product.product a corregir UNIT_COST = 2.089 # <-- x: coste unitario CORRECTO. RELLENAR (>0) ANTES DE ACTIVAR BATCH_SIZE = 150 # Pedidos por ejecución COMPANY_IDS = [7] # company_id a procesar DATE_FROM = '2026-06-02 22:00:00' # date_order >= (UTC) DATE_TO = '2026-06-23 10:59:59' # date_order <= (UTC) SAVEPOINT = 'pos_cost_fix' # Nombre del savepoint por registro
# --- Guarda de seguridad: no ejecutar con x sin configurar --- if UNIT_COST <= 0.0: log(f'UNIT_COST sin configurar (x={UNIT_COST}). Aborta el lote sin cambios.', level='warning') else: # Dominio: empresa + producto + rango de fechas + AÚN no procesados. # 'not ilike' incluye los pedidos con note vacío (IS NULL) -> permite paginar de 100 en 100. domain = [ ('company_id', 'in', COMPANY_IDS), ('lines.product_id', 'in', [PRODUCT_ID]), ('date_order', '>=', DATE_FROM), ('date_order', '<=', DATE_TO), ('note', 'not ilike', MARKER), ]
orders = model.search(domain, limit=BATCH_SIZE, order='date_order asc')
processed = 0 failed = 0
for order in orders: # Doble barrera de idempotencia (por si el note ya contiene el marcador) if order.note and MARKER in order.note: continue
# Savepoint por registro: aísla fallos; un pedido malo no revierte el lote entero env.cr.execute(f'SAVEPOINT {SAVEPOINT}') try: lines_to_fix = order.lines.filtered(lambda l: l.product_id.id == PRODUCT_ID) if not lines_to_fix: env.cr.execute(f'RELEASE SAVEPOINT {SAVEPOINT}') continue
for line in lines_to_fix: coste = line.qty * UNIT_COST # margen = subtotal sin impuestos − coste (qty negativa en devoluciones -> valores negativos, correcto) line.write({ 'total_cost': coste, 'margin': line.price_subtotal - coste, 'is_total_cost_computed': True, # mantiene los campos visibles/blindados })
# Marcar el pedido como procesado (preservando la nota existente) nota_actual = order.note or '' order.write({'note': f'{nota_actual}\n{MARKER}' if nota_actual else MARKER})
env.cr.execute(f'RELEASE SAVEPOINT {SAVEPOINT}') processed += 1 except Exception as e: env.cr.execute(f'ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT {SAVEPOINT}') env.cr.execute(f'RELEASE SAVEPOINT {SAVEPOINT}') failed += 1 log(f'Error en pedido id={order.id}: {e}', level='warning')
log(f'Lote terminado: {processed} corregidos, {failed} con error, {len(orders)} candidatos.')

# ========================================================================== # Inventory adjustment for POS tickets # Server action model: pos.order # # Three selection sources, decided per order, first match wins: # # MODE A (lines) -> at least one pos.order.line has x_studio_ticket_error # -> adjust stock from those lines # MODE B (product) -> no line flagged, but x_studio_product is filled # -> adjust stock from the ticket qty of those products # MODE C (fill) -> neither of the above # -> DO NOT touch stock; prefill x_studio_product with # the products of the ticket whose total quantity is # greater than MIN_QTY_FILL, capped at MAX_FILL and # ordered by quantity descending # # Mode C is a preparation step. After it runs the user presses the button # again and mode B performs the actual adjustment. # # BOTH adjusting modes ADD the quantity back to stock (10 + 2 = 12). # To make mode A subtract again, set SIGN_LINES = -1.0 and nothing else. # # The note is ALWAYS written, on every path, so each run leaves a trace. # # Traceability: # stock.move.line reference -> "data: <pos.order id>" (+ " dev" on mode B) # pos.order note field -> stamp, one marker per mode; only the markers # of an applied adjustment block a rerun # ==========================================================================
# --- Fields ----------------------------------------------------------------- ERROR_FIELD = "x_studio_ticket_error" # boolean on pos.order.line PRODUCT_FIELD = "x_studio_product" # many2many product.product on pos.order QTY_FIELD = "qty" NOTE_FIELD = "note" # <-- change here if the field is named otherwise
# --- Modes ------------------------------------------------------------------ MODE_LINES = "lines" MODE_PRODUCT = "product" MODE_FILL = "fill" SIGN_LINES = 1.0 # add back to stock SIGN_PRODUCT = 1.0 # add back to stock
# --- Mode C criteria -------------------------------------------------------- # No product type filter: product.type is not reliably readable from the POS # order context, so every product of the ticket is a candidate. MIN_QTY_FILL = 0.0 # strictly greater than this. Keep at 0.0: weighted products # sell as 0.032 kg and any higher threshold drops them all. MAX_FILL = 10 # cap on how many products get prefilled, highest qty first
# --- Markers ---------------------------------------------------------------- # Blocking (an adjustment was applied): MARKER_LINES = "data: corregido" MARKER_PRODUCT = "data: devuelto" # Non blocking (trace only, a rerun is still allowed): MARKER_FILL = "data: preparado" MARKER_NOOP = "data: sin ajuste"
# --- Traceability ----------------------------------------------------------- REF_PREFIX = "data: " REF_SUFFIX_RETURN = " dev"
# --- Safety ----------------------------------------------------------------- MAX_RECORDS = 40 # one SAVEPOINT per record, PostgreSQL subXID limit SAVEPOINT = "pos_ticket_error" CLEAR_FLAG = True # unset the line flag after a mode A adjustment POST_CHATTER = True # also log a note in the chatter when available FALLBACK_TZ = "Europe/Madrid" PRECISION = 3
# --- Pre-flight: fail loudly if the note field does not exist --------------- Order = env["pos.order"] if NOTE_FIELD not in Order._fields: raise UserError( "El campo '%s' no existe en pos.order. Revisa Ajustes > Tecnico > Campos " "y ajusta la constante NOTE_FIELD." % NOTE_FIELD ) if PRODUCT_FIELD not in Order._fields: raise UserError("El campo '%s' no existe en pos.order." % PRODUCT_FIELD) HAS_CHATTER = "message_ids" in Order._fields
# --- Batch guard ------------------------------------------------------------ if len(records) > MAX_RECORDS: raise UserError( "Selecciona como maximo %s pedidos por lote (has seleccionado %s)." % (MAX_RECORDS, len(records)) )
# --- Correction stamp in the user's timezone -------------------------------- user_tz = env.user.tz or FALLBACK_TZ now_local = timezone("UTC").localize(datetime.datetime.utcnow()).astimezone(timezone(user_tz)) stamp_suffix = " " + now_local.strftime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M")
action = None done = [] filled = [] skipped = [] noop = [] empty = [] warnings = [] errors = []
for order in records: env.cr.execute("SAVEPOINT " + SAVEPOINT) try: # ---- 1. Single pass over the ticket ---------------------------------- target_products = order[PRODUCT_FIELD] flagged_lines = env["pos.order.line"] qty_flagged = {} qty_target = {} qty_all = {} product_by_id = {}
for line in order.lines: product = line.product_id if not product: continue qty = line[QTY_FIELD] or 0.0 product_by_id[product.id] = product qty_all[product.id] = qty_all.get(product.id, 0.0) + qty if line[ERROR_FIELD]: flagged_lines |= line qty_flagged[product.id] = qty_flagged.get(product.id, 0.0) + qty if product in target_products: qty_target[product.id] = qty_target.get(product.id, 0.0) + qty
existing_note = order[NOTE_FIELD] or ""
# ---- 2. MODE C: nothing selected -> prefill the many2many ------------- order_ref = REF_PREFIX + str(order.id)
if not qty_flagged and not target_products: candidates = [] rejected = [] for product_id in qty_all: product = product_by_id[product_id] qty = qty_all[product_id] if float_compare(qty, MIN_QTY_FILL, precision_digits=PRECISION) <= 0: rejected.append("%s (cantidad %.3f)" % (product.display_name, qty)) continue candidates.append((qty, product_id, product.display_name))
# Highest quantity first, so the cap keeps the most relevant lines candidates = sorted(candidates, reverse=True) overflow = [] if len(candidates) > MAX_FILL: for item in candidates[MAX_FILL:]: overflow.append(item[2]) candidates = candidates[:MAX_FILL]
fill_ids = [] fill_names = [] for item in candidates: fill_ids.append(item[1]) fill_names.append(item[2])
if fill_ids: order.write({PRODUCT_FIELD: [Command.set(fill_ids)]}) stamp = (MARKER_FILL + stamp_suffix + " [" + order_ref + "]" + " | propuestos: " + ", ".join(fill_names)) filled.append(order.name) else: stamp = (MARKER_NOOP + stamp_suffix + " [" + order_ref + "]" + " | sin productos con cantidad > %s" % MIN_QTY_FILL) empty.append(order.name) if overflow: stamp = (stamp + " | fuera del tope de %s: " % MAX_FILL + ", ".join(overflow)) warnings.append( order.name + ": el ticket supera el tope de %s productos, " "quedan fuera %s" % (MAX_FILL, len(overflow)) ) if rejected: stamp = stamp + " | descartados: " + ", ".join(rejected)
new_note = existing_note + "\n" + stamp if existing_note else stamp order.write({NOTE_FIELD: new_note}) if POST_CHATTER and HAS_CHATTER: order.message_post(body=stamp, subtype_xmlid="mail.mt_note") env.flush_all() _logger.info("[ticket_error] %s | %s | %s", order.name, MODE_FILL, stamp) env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + SAVEPOINT) continue
# ---- 3. Decide the adjusting mode ------------------------------------- if qty_flagged: mode = MODE_LINES marker = MARKER_LINES sign = SIGN_LINES qty_by_product = qty_flagged move_ref = REF_PREFIX + str(order.id) else: mode = MODE_PRODUCT marker = MARKER_PRODUCT sign = SIGN_PRODUCT qty_by_product = qty_target move_ref = REF_PREFIX + str(order.id) + REF_SUFFIX_RETURN
# ---- 4. Idempotency, evaluated per mode ------------------------------ if marker in existing_note: skipped.append(order.name) env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + SAVEPOINT) continue
# ---- 5. Selected products missing from the ticket -------------------- missing = [] if mode == MODE_PRODUCT: for product in target_products: if product.id not in qty_target: missing.append(product.display_name) warnings.append( order.name + ": " + product.display_name + " no esta en el ticket" )
# ---- 6. Nothing to adjust: leave a trace, without a blocking marker --- if not qty_by_product: detail = "ningun producto coincide con el ticket" if missing: detail = "no esta en el ticket: " + ", ".join(missing) stamp = MARKER_NOOP + stamp_suffix + " [" + move_ref + "] | " + detail new_note = existing_note + "\n" + stamp if existing_note else stamp order.write({NOTE_FIELD: new_note}) if POST_CHATTER and HAS_CHATTER: order.message_post(body=stamp, subtype_xmlid="mail.mt_note") env.flush_all() noop.append(order.name) env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + SAVEPOINT) continue
# ---- 7. Source location ---------------------------------------------- company = order.company_id or env.company location = order.config_id.picking_type_id.default_location_src_id if not location and order.picking_ids: location = order.picking_ids[:1].location_id if not location: raise UserError("El pedido %s no tiene ubicacion de origen." % order.name)
# ---- 8. Apply the inventory count ------------------------------------ Quant = env["stock.quant"].sudo().with_company(company.id).with_context( inventory_mode=True, inventory_name=move_ref)
resumen = [] for product_id in qty_by_product: qty = qty_by_product[product_id] if float_compare(qty, 0.0, precision_digits=PRECISION) == 0: continue product = product_by_id[product_id] quant = Quant.search([ ("product_id", "=", product_id), ("location_id", "=", location.id), ("lot_id", "=", False), ("package_id", "=", False), ("owner_id", "=", False), ], limit=1) actual = quant.quantity if quant else 0.0 objetivo = actual + (sign * qty) if quant: quant.write({"inventory_quantity": objetivo}) else: quant = Quant.create({ "product_id": product_id, "location_id": location.id, "inventory_quantity": objetivo, }) quant.action_apply_inventory() resumen.append("%s: %.3f -> %.3f" % (product.display_name, actual, objetivo))
# ---- 9. Note on every path, then flush inside the savepoint ----------- if resumen: stamp = (marker + stamp_suffix + " [" + move_ref + "] | " + " ; ".join(resumen)) done.append(order.name) else: stamp = (MARKER_NOOP + stamp_suffix + " [" + move_ref + "]" + " | cantidades a cero") noop.append(order.name) if missing: stamp = stamp + " | no esta en el ticket: " + ", ".join(missing)
new_note = existing_note + "\n" + stamp if existing_note else stamp order.write({NOTE_FIELD: new_note}) if POST_CHATTER and HAS_CHATTER: order.message_post(body=stamp, subtype_xmlid="mail.mt_note") if CLEAR_FLAG and resumen and mode == MODE_LINES and flagged_lines: flagged_lines.write({ERROR_FIELD: False}) env.flush_all()
_logger.info("[ticket_error] %s | %s | %s | %s", order.name, mode, move_ref, stamp) env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + SAVEPOINT)
except UserError as e: env.cr.clear() env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + SAVEPOINT) env.invalidate_all(flush=False) errors.append(order.name + ": " + str(e))
except Exception as e: env.cr.clear() env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + SAVEPOINT) env.invalidate_all(flush=False) errors.append(order.name + ": " + str(e)) _logger.warning("[ticket_error] %s: %s", order.display_name, e)
# --- Single notification covering every outcome ----------------------------- sections = [] if filled: sections.append("Productos propuestos, revisa y vuelve a pulsar: " + ", ".join(filled)) if done: sections.append("Corregidos: " + ", ".join(done)) if skipped: sections.append("Ya corregidos: " + ", ".join(skipped)) if noop: sections.append("Sin ajuste: " + ", ".join(noop)) if empty: sections.append("Sin productos que proponer: " + ", ".join(empty)) if warnings: sections.append("Avisos: " + " ; ".join(warnings)) if errors: sections.append("Errores: " + " ; ".join(errors))
if sections: if errors: kind = "danger" elif warnings or skipped or noop: kind = "warning" elif filled: kind = "info" else: kind = "success" action = { "type": "ir.actions.client", "tag": "display_notification", "params": { "title": "Correccion de ticket", "message": " | ".join(sections), "type": kind, "sticky": True if (errors or warnings or filled) else False, }, }

# ===================================================================== # Server action: re-tax POS order lines flagged as "Ticket error" # Model: pos.order (run from list or form: Acción -> this action) # Odoo: 17 (safe_eval compatible: no def / lambda / import / with, # no getattr/hasattr, no direct attribute assignment) # # For every selected order, each line with x_studio_ticket_error: # 1. Gets TARGET_TAX_ID (20% Inclusive) as its only tax # 2. Recomputes price_subtotal / price_subtotal_incl exactly as # Odoo does (price_unit, discount, qty, currency rounding) # 3. The order amount_tax is recomputed; amount_total must not change # 4. An audit entry is appended to the order "Notas" (note field) # 5. The "Ticket error" flag is cleared again # Margin (line + order) is recomputed automatically by Odoo. # Any validation error rolls back the whole run (nothing half-applied). # =====================================================================
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- # Constants # --------------------------------------------------------------------- TARGET_TAX_ID = 1856 # "20% (Inclusive)" -- ID differs per instance FLAG_FIELD = 'x_studio_ticket_error' # boolean on pos.order.line BLOCKED_ORDER_STATES = ['draft', 'cancel', 'invoiced'] ALLOW_CLOSED_SESSIONS = True # closed session => accounting needs manual adjustment LOG_PREFIX = '[TICKET_ERROR_VAT]' NOTIFY_STICKY = True NOTE_DATE_FORMAT = '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M' NOTE_SEPARATOR = '\n\n' EMPTY_TAX_LABEL = 'Sin impuesto'
# Messages MSG_NO_TAX = '%s El impuesto con ID %s no existe en esta base de datos.' MSG_NOT_INCLUDED = '%s El impuesto "%s" no es "incluido en el precio": el total del ticket cambiaría y dejaría de cuadrar con los pagos.' MSG_BLOCKED_STATE = '%s El pedido %s está facturado, cancelado o en borrador. Si está facturado hay que emitir una factura rectificativa.' MSG_WRONG_COMPANY = '%s El impuesto "%s" pertenece a %s y el pedido %s a %s.' MSG_CLOSED_SESSION = '%s La sesión %s del pedido %s ya está cerrada.' MSG_FPOS_MAPPING = '%s La posición fiscal "%s" del pedido %s convierte "%s" en "%s". Quita la posición fiscal o revisa el mapeo.' MSG_TOTAL_CHANGED = '%s El total del pedido %s cambiaría de %s a %s. Cambio cancelado.' MSG_LOG_OK = '%s %s -> IVA %s %s (total %s sin cambios)%s' MSG_LOG_CLOSED = ' | SESION CERRADA: requiere asiento de ajuste' MSG_TITLE = 'IVA corregido' MSG_NOTHING = 'No hay líneas con "Ticket error" pendientes de corregir en los pedidos seleccionados.' MSG_DONE = '%s línea(s) corregidas en %s pedido(s): %s.' MSG_DONE_CLOSED = ' Pedidos de sesión cerrada: %s (requieren asiento de ajuste).' NOTE_HEADER = '[Corrección IVA] %s UTC - %s' NOTE_LINE = '- %s (cant. %s): %s -> %s | base %s -> %s' NOTE_FOOTER = 'IVA del pedido: %s -> %s %s (total %s sin cambios)' NOTE_CLOSED = 'Sesión %s cerrada: requiere asiento de ajuste contable.'
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- # 1. Validate the target tax # --------------------------------------------------------------------- target_tax = env['account.tax'].browse(TARGET_TAX_ID).exists() if not target_tax: raise UserError(MSG_NO_TAX % (LOG_PREFIX, TARGET_TAX_ID)) if not target_tax.price_include: raise UserError(MSG_NOT_INCLUDED % (LOG_PREFIX, target_tax.name))
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- # 2. Collect flagged lines that still need the change (idempotent) # --------------------------------------------------------------------- lines_to_fix = env['pos.order.line'] lines_flag_only = env['pos.order.line'] # flagged but already on target tax for selected_order in records: for line in selected_order.lines: if line[FLAG_FIELD]: if line.tax_ids != target_tax: lines_to_fix |= line else: lines_flag_only |= line
orders = lines_to_fix.mapped('order_id')
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- # 3. Validate every affected order BEFORE writing anything # --------------------------------------------------------------------- for order in orders: if order.state in BLOCKED_ORDER_STATES or order.account_move: raise UserError(MSG_BLOCKED_STATE % (LOG_PREFIX, order.name)) if target_tax.company_id != order.company_id: raise UserError(MSG_WRONG_COMPANY % (LOG_PREFIX, target_tax.name, target_tax.company_id.name, order.name, order.company_id.name)) if order.session_id.state == 'closed' and not ALLOW_CLOSED_SESSIONS: raise UserError(MSG_CLOSED_SESSION % (LOG_PREFIX, order.session_id.name, order.name)) if order.fiscal_position_id: mapped_tax = order.fiscal_position_id.map_tax(target_tax) if mapped_tax != target_tax: raise UserError(MSG_FPOS_MAPPING % (LOG_PREFIX, order.fiscal_position_id.name, order.name, target_tax.name, ', '.join(mapped_tax.mapped('name'))))
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- # 4. Re-tax each line (mirrors PosOrderLine._compute_amount_line_all) # --------------------------------------------------------------------- note_lines = {} # order.id -> list of audit lines old_order_tax = {} # order.id -> amount_tax before the change for order in orders: note_lines[order.id] = [] old_order_tax[order.id] = order.amount_tax
for line in lines_to_fix: order = line.order_id old_tax_label = ', '.join(line.tax_ids.mapped('name')) or EMPTY_TAX_LABEL old_subtotal = line.price_subtotal price = line.price_unit * (1 - (line.discount or 0.0) / 100.0) tax_result = target_tax.compute_all( price, currency=order.currency_id, quantity=line.qty, product=line.product_id, partner=order.partner_id, ) line.write({ 'tax_ids': [(6, 0, [target_tax.id])], 'price_subtotal': tax_result['total_excluded'], 'price_subtotal_incl': tax_result['total_included'], FLAG_FIELD: False, }) note_lines[order.id].append(NOTE_LINE % ( line.full_product_name or line.product_id.display_name, line.qty, old_tax_label, target_tax.name, old_subtotal, tax_result['total_excluded']))
if lines_flag_only: lines_flag_only.write({FLAG_FIELD: False})
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- # 5. Recompute order totals (mirrors PosOrder._compute_batch_amount_all) # --------------------------------------------------------------------- closed_order_names = [] now_label = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime(NOTE_DATE_FORMAT) for order in orders: currency = order.currency_id total_included = 0.0 total_excluded = 0.0 for order_line in order.lines: total_included += order_line.price_subtotal_incl total_excluded += order_line.price_subtotal
new_total = currency.round(total_included) new_tax = currency.round(total_included - total_excluded)
if currency.compare_amounts(new_total, order.amount_total) != 0: raise UserError(MSG_TOTAL_CHANGED % (LOG_PREFIX, order.name, order.amount_total, new_total))
session_note = '' audit = [NOTE_HEADER % (now_label, env.user.name)] audit.extend(note_lines[order.id]) audit.append(NOTE_FOOTER % (old_order_tax[order.id], new_tax, currency.name, new_total)) if order.session_id.state == 'closed': session_note = MSG_LOG_CLOSED closed_order_names.append('%s (%s)' % (order.name, order.session_id.name)) audit.append(NOTE_CLOSED % order.session_id.name)
audit_text = '\n'.join(audit) if order.note: audit_text = order.note + NOTE_SEPARATOR + audit_text
order.write({'amount_tax': new_tax, 'note': audit_text}) log(MSG_LOG_OK % (LOG_PREFIX, order.name, new_tax, currency.name, new_total, session_note), level='info')
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- # 6. User feedback # --------------------------------------------------------------------- notify_type = 'warning' notify_message = MSG_NOTHING if lines_to_fix: notify_type = 'success' notify_message = MSG_DONE % (len(lines_to_fix), len(orders), ', '.join(orders.mapped('name'))) if closed_order_names: notify_type = 'warning' notify_message += MSG_DONE_CLOSED % ', '.join(closed_order_names)
action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': MSG_TITLE, 'message': notify_message, 'type': notify_type, 'sticky': NOTIFY_STICKY, 'next': {'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'soft_reload'}, }, }
